changeSet.author: samuelmale
changeSet.comment: Strip the /rest prefix from system_module_url rows so they can match a request path
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_module_url redundant WHERE redundant.url_path LIKE '/rest/%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url existing WHERE existing.url_path = SUBSTRING(redundant.url_path FROM 6) AND existing.system_module_id = redundant.system_module_id AND existing.system_module_param_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM redundant.system_module_param_id );

rollback.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id, system_module_param_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), '/rest/GenericSampleOrder', system_module_id, system_module_param_id FROM clinlims.system_module_url WHERE url_path = '/GenericSampleOrder' LIMIT 1;

UPDATE clinlims.system_module_url SET url_path = '/rest' || url_path WHERE url_path IN ('/alerts', '/eqa', '/qc', '/reports/amendment', '/GenericSampleOrder/import', '/GenericSampleOrder/validate', '/reports/vector-surveillance/manual-entry', '/reports/vector-surveillance/manual-entry/submit', '/admin/vector/manual-entry-fields');
